metadata.description: Four small Claude Code mods: hide secrets from tool results, see how far your plan is, get warned when a task is marked done with untested code, and see what fills the context window and when the prompt cache expires.

plugins.name: secret-guard
plugins.description: Hides secrets in tool results before Claude reads them: the secret values of every .env and .env.* from your session's folder up to the drive root, and anything that looks like a secret (KEY=VALUE under a secret name, passwords in URLs, private keys, JWTs, AWS keys, Kubernetes Secrets); tells Claude how to use them without printing them

plugins.name: plan-meter
plugins.description: A band above the prompt with how far your plan file is (phases and steps done, what is in progress, what is next) and Claude's own task list, kept current as files change. Starts off: /plan-meter on turns it on

plugins.name: done-gate
plugins.description: Notices when Claude marks a task done while code it changed has not been tested since, and tells Claude and you; a band shows the last test run. It warns, it never blocks. Starts off: /done-gate on turns it on

plugins.name: context-meter
plugins.description: A band above the prompt with what fills the context window, by category, a countdown to when the prompt cache expires, and a Compact button. Starts off: /context-meter on turns it on
